title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time; emit explicit audit events for KMS selection and region denial; add migration to backfill KMS residency metadata; update docs and policy examples.
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require strict data residency controls and auditable decisions when keys are selected. Existing RBAC v2 checks validated role/tenant permissions but allowed KMS selection paths that could result in cross-region key usage without an explicit deny/audit path. This PR enforces region pinning in the RBAC v2 evaluation pipeline and improves audit logging to record KMS selection decisions and denial reasons. Summary: 1) Add region-pinning evaluation to the RBAC v2 policy engine; 2) Emit structured audit events whenever a KMS key is chosen or when region constraints cause a deny/fallback; 3) Migration to backfill kms_residency metadata for existing keys; 4) Tests + docs + rollout helper to disable enforcement per-customer during rollout. Checklist: [x] Add engine-level region pin check; [x] Wire audit events (pkg/audit/events.go) with KMS decision payload; [x] Add migration 20260122_backfill_kms_region.sql; [x] Integration tests for allowed/denied requests; [x] Docs and examples updated; [x] Add rollout flag and metrics; [x] Security review done and approval received. Impact: Default behavior remains backwards-compatible until enforcement flag is enabled for a tenant. Once enforcement is turned on the policy engine will reject requests that reference KMS keys outside the pinned region unless an explicit allow policy exists. Rollout notes: staged rollout enabled via feature flag 'rbac.v2.kms_region_enforce' and include a 7-day audit-only window to catch false-positives.
